firm_data.firm_name: New York Lawyers for the Public Interest
firm_data.firm_description: New York Lawyers for the Public Interest (NYLPI) is a non-profit law firm that combines the power of law, organizing, and the private bar to make lasting change where it’s needed most, fighting for more than 40 years to protect civil rights and achieve lived equality for communities in need.
notable_facts: Pioneered the practice of community lawyering in New York

additional_contacts.name: Daryl Samuel
additional_contacts.title: Director of Human Resources and Administration

email.subject: AI for NYLPI, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi McGregor,

NYLPI's work across Civil Rights, Health Justice, and Disability Justice for over 40 years represents exactly the kind of high-impact legal practice that demands precision and trust. I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams.

We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in New York to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your office to share how ex-lawyers built Lucio to help firms like yours amplify impact without sacrificing quality.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
